data.name: Sanmitha
data.gender_notes: Sanmitha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sanmitha is a combination of two words: 'San' means 'Goddess' and 'Mitha' means 'Wealth'. This name is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and good fortune to the bearer. The name Sanmitha carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sanmitha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the abundance and richness of the universe, encouraging growth and abundance in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: Sanmitha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sanmitha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sanmitha is rooted in Hindu mythology and is believed to be auspicious and bestowed with divine blessings. It suggests a deep connection with the Goddesses, and the belief that the deity's blessings will bring wealth and prosperity. In Hindu culture, names are deeply meaningful and represent the values and attributes that one aspires to possess.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sanmitha carries a profound spiritual significance, representing the pursuit of material abundance and spiritual wealth. It symbolizes the idea that true wealth lies in the blessings of the divine, and that the material riches are only a means to live a comfortable and fulfilling life, which in turn allows one to focus on the path of spiritual growth and enlightenment. The name also encourages the belief in the power of the divine, and trust in the universe to provide for one's needs.
